fields.description: Fieldname on Document Type that identifies who currently owns/is responsible for the document (used for the Confidentiality Level 'Owner Can Read' rule). Defaults to the standard 'owner' meta field - override if the doctype tracks ownership under a different fieldname (e.g. Correspondence uses 'current_owner').
fields.label: Owner Field

fields.description: Fieldname on Document Type that holds its workflow/lifecycle status - used to build generic per-status Number Cards and reports.
fields.label: Status Field

fields.description: Fieldname on Document Type that holds its human-readable reference/document number - used by the unified search result display.
fields.label: Reference Field

fields.description: Link fields on Document Type that hold a department (or whichever doctype is currently providing 'Department') used for department scoping - e.g. 'department', or 'from_department'+'to_department' for a doctype with two. A user sees the document if ANY one of these fields' value is one of their own departments (logical OR across rows) - or if their role is in Department Exempt Roles below. Leave empty if this type is not department-scoped at all.
fields.label: Department Fields

fields.description: Roles that see documents of this type across every department, regardless of their own User Permission department assignment. Confidentiality tiering (below) still applies independently.
fields.label: Department Exempt Roles

fields.description: Fieldname on Document Type holding a Link to Confidentiality Level.
fields.label: Confidentiality Field

fields.description: Name of a child-table doctype, shaped like {parent, parenttype, user}, listing users explicitly authorized to read an otherwise-restricted document of this type - e.g. Correspondence Authorized Viewer. Leave blank if this type has no such mechanism (bypass roles + owner + department rules still apply).
fields.label: Authorized Viewer Doctype

fields.description: Master doctype this type's reference-number prefix is configured on, e.g. Correspondence Type.
fields.label: Numbering Prefix Source Doctype

fields.description: Fieldname on that master doctype holding the prefix string, e.g. 'prefix'.
fields.label: Numbering Prefix Source Field

fields.description: Fields queried by the unified search across all registered document types.
fields.label: Searchable Fields
